description: New York Truck Voucher Incentive Program (NYTVIP) Projects Reported By NYSERDA: Beginning 2019 is a dataset listed in State of New York open data portal (data.ny.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of New York. The New York Truck Voucher Incentive Program (NYTVIP), administered by the New York State Energy Research and Development Authority (NYSERDA), reduces the cost for truck, transit, and school bus fleets to purchase zero-emission vehicle technologies. Coverage: New York State. The portal files it under the category Energy & Environment. Its tags are truck voucher, battery electric, cng, electric bus, electric school buses. The table has 18 columns. Attribution on the portal: New York State Energy Research and Development Authority (NYSERDA). The portal shows 2026-07-01 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support freight and delivery logistics studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ny-gov-portal.
